title: Databases owned by NOLOGIN roles
description: Return databases whose owner has can_login = 0. Return exactly two columns: database_name, owner_role. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.name AS database_name, r.role_name AS owner_role
FROM databases AS d
hints: The can_login filter applies to the joined role.
solution_explanation: The join allows databases to be filtered by a property of their owner.
